content.label: Examiner note - cracking is supply-and-demand chemistry
content.body: Cracking splits long-chain alkanes into shorter alkanes AND alkenes (heat + a catalyst - silica/alumina or zeolite, around 500 degrees C industrially). Why bother? Because the market wants small molecules: petrol, and alkenes for polymers. The long fractions oversupply; cracking re-balances supply against demand - and every alkene so made is feedstock for the polymers chapter.
